chooser.title: Who is signing in?
chooser.subtitle: Choose how you want to use the app.
chooser.tutorHint: Manage one or more children's progress.
chooser.kid: I'm a child with my own account
chooser.kidHint: Sign in with your Google account and start learning.

google.roleTitle: Is this your account or your child's?
google.roleSubtitle: Tell us who will use this Google account.

adultChallenge.title: Quick check for grown-ups
adultChallenge.body: To confirm you're an adult, solve this:
adultChallenge.question: How much is {{a}} × {{b}}?
adultChallenge.wrong: That's not right. Please try again.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.body: We've sent a verification link to your email. Open it, then come back and tap the button below.
verify.stillPending: Your email isn't verified yet. Check your inbox and try again.

profileSetup.limitReached: You've reached the maximum number of children for this account.

migrationNotice.title: Your progress will move here
migrationNotice.body: The progress saved on this device will be added to this profile, so nothing is lost.
migrationNotice.multiCourse: Progress from every course you've played on this device will be transferred.

migration.inProgress: Saving your progress to the cloud…
migration.doneToast: Your progress is safely in the cloud.
migration.incompleteBody: We couldn't finish saving part of your progress to the cloud. It's still safe on this device and we'll keep trying.

pin.setBody: This 4-digit PIN keeps siblings from opening the wrong profile. It stays only on this device.
pin.label: 4-digit PIN
pin.invalid: The PIN must be exactly 4 digits.
